blocks.h: Natural health products: does this line need Purified Water?
blocks.intro: Potable water is the minimum; Purified Water only where your specification or a monograph asks. GUI-0158 asks for test records and qualified, monitored treatment.

rows.t: If this is your first system

items.q: How is water qualified for a natural health product line?
items.a: GUI-0158 asks for documented water quality criteria, test records, source water analyses, and calibrated, maintained treatment. Our scope for this: [NHP qualification scope]. Where your quality assurance person requires it, we also run installation, operational and performance qualification (IQ, OQ, PQ).
items.intent: I know my product, not my water spec|Natural health products

items.q: Do you supply WFI, pure steam or stainless steel?
items.a: No. Our scope is one Purified Water (PW) package in polypropylene. Water for Injection (WFI), pure steam, stills and stainless steel systems sit outside it.

items.q: Can one system supply Canada, the United States and Europe?
items.a: Yes. Where USP and Ph. Eur. differ, we design to the stricter value. The functional specification names both, and the factory acceptance test (FAT) checks both where methods allow.

items.q: Does a new production line mean full requalification?
items.a: Not normally. GUI-0001 asks that changes are validated before use; a risk assessment sets the scope. Usually: installation and operational qualification (IQ, OQ) of the new section, and extra sampling at its points of use.

items.q: Can our quality unit audit you before we order?
items.a: Yes. Audit our quality system on [on-site audit notice, working days] notice. Visit the shop and test bay by appointment, [shop visit notice, working days] notice. Witness your factory acceptance test (FAT) with [FAT witness notice, working days] notice.
